description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Composite' which implements a composite validator pattern for CSS attribute values, allowing multiple validator objects to attempt validation and return a positive result if any pass.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Composite
classes.description: A composite validator class that holds multiple attribute definition objects and validates input by consulting each validator until one accepts the value.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor which initializes the composite with a list of validator objects.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Attempts to validate a string against all validator objects contained within; returns the first successful validation result or false if none pass.
